levels.label: Bounded failure capture
levels.allowed_claim: A declared command failure can be captured with target identity, exit code, bounded output, and a next action.
levels.forbidden_inference: The capsule reproduces the failure or contains all machine state.

levels.label: Redaction and omissions
levels.allowed_claim: Sensitive key/value output is redacted and omitted capture classes are named before persistence.
levels.forbidden_inference: All possible secrets or sensitive content are detected.

levels.label: Inspect-only handoff
levels.allowed_claim: A saved capsule can be inspected without running the failed command.
levels.forbidden_inference: The failure has been repaired or replayed.

levels.label: Current dev checkpoint
levels.status_display: Capture and checks reproduce on dev
levels.allowed_claim: The current dev head passes its local checks and reproduces a redacted failed capture with inspect-only opening.
levels.forbidden_inference: The current dev head has complete replay, cancellation, recovery, or hosted coverage.

levels.label: Replay and cancellation matrix
levels.allowed_claim: The capsule records an explicit next action for review and rerun.
levels.forbidden_inference: Cancellation, replay, and recovery behavior are fully proven.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The capsule case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
